info.title: Navidrome API
info.description:
Navidrome API v1. Spec-first, additive within v1. Clients discover implemented
capability modules through `GET /server` and never sniff versions.

Enums are open: new values may be added to any enum within v1. Clients must
accept values they do not recognise instead of failing.

Every operation declares `x-stability-level`: `alpha` operations may change or
disappear without notice, `beta` and `stable` operations only change additively.
A level is only ever raised, never lowered.

`HEAD` is accepted wherever `GET` is. A `405` response lists the allowed methods
in its `Allow` header.

bearerAuth.description: Short-lived access token minted from a device grant. Not yet applied to any operation.

ServerInfo.description: Public server description. Everything an add-server screen needs before login.

serverVersion.description: Version of the running server build.

specVersion.description: Version of the OpenAPI document this server implements.

setupRequired.description: True until the first admin user has been created.

loginMethods.description: Login methods this server accepts. New methods may be added; clients ignore values they do not recognise.

Problem.description: RFC 9457 problem details, returned for every 4xx and 5xx response.

type.description:
URI reference identifying the problem type. Omitted while the problem carries no semantics
beyond its HTTP status code, which RFC 9457 defines as `about:blank`. Problems with their
own semantics get their own URI; switch on `code` instead.

title.description: Short human-readable summary, the same for all occurrences of this problem type.

status.description: HTTP status code of this response.

detail.description: Human-readable explanation specific to this occurrence. Omitted for internal errors.

code.description: Machine-readable error code, and the value clients switch on. New codes may be added.

errors.description: Per-field failures. Present only when `code` is `validation`.

field.description: Name of the offending query parameter, path parameter, or body field (dotted for nested).

InternalError.description: Unexpected server failure. Details are in the server log.
